subject.title: fix(talk): reject malformed relay audio base64

question: Should Talk gateway-relay audio enforce standard base64 only, or preserve the previously tolerated base64url alphabet for external clients?
rationale: Current documentation and the Control UI use standard base64, but the shipped Buffer decoder also accepts base64url; choosing whether that permissiveness is accidental or compatibility-relevant requires owner intent.

options.title: Enforce documented standard base64
options.body: Confirm standard base64 as the supported wire contract, add focused coverage for deliberately rejected base64url input, and require live configured relay proof before merge.

options.title: Preserve base64url compatibility
options.body: Normalize the base64url alphabet before strict validation so malformed input is rejected without breaking clients that relied on Node's permissive decoder.

recommendation.title: Enforce documented standard base64
recommendation.body: Confirm standard base64 as the supported wire contract, add focused coverage for deliberately rejected base64url input, and require live configured relay proof before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: The merged history connects this person to the unified Talk session and relay architecture being tightened.
